title: Debate
learning_outcomes: Explain claims and rebuttals in the context of debate.
Compare and distinguish evidence versus rhetoric in the context of debate.
Apply respectful cross-examination in the context of debate.
Evaluate and justify decisions about revision in the context of debate.

lessons.title: Claims and rebuttals
lessons.outcome: Explain claims and rebuttals in the context of debate.
lessons.worked_example_brief: Use a realistic fictional case involving claims and rebuttals; show reasoning, a contrasting case and limitations.
lessons.practice: Create an annotated explanation with a concrete example and a counterexample. Connect the result to structured debate.
lessons.knowledge_check: Explain claims and rebuttals from memory and apply it to a different example; state one limitation.
lessons.evidence_criterion: Accurate explanation of claims and rebuttals; correct application to a new case; clear rationale and limits.

lessons.title: Evidence versus rhetoric
lessons.outcome: Compare and distinguish evidence versus rhetoric in the context of debate.
lessons.worked_example_brief: Use a realistic fictional case involving evidence versus rhetoric; show reasoning, a contrasting case and limitations.
lessons.practice: Compare two cases or approaches using explicit criteria; identify an important limitation. Connect the result to structured debate.
lessons.knowledge_check: Explain evidence versus rhetoric from memory and apply it to a different example; state one limitation.
lessons.evidence_criterion: Accurate explanation of evidence versus rhetoric; correct application to a new case; clear rationale and limits.

lessons.title: Respectful cross-examination
lessons.outcome: Apply respectful cross-examination in the context of debate.
lessons.worked_example_brief: Use a realistic fictional case involving respectful cross-examination; show reasoning, a contrasting case and limitations.
lessons.practice: Work through a new case or simulation; document assumptions and steps. Connect the result to structured debate.
lessons.knowledge_check: Explain respectful cross-examination from memory and apply it to a different example; state one limitation.
lessons.evidence_criterion: Accurate explanation of respectful cross-examination; correct application to a new case; clear rationale and limits.

lessons.title: Revision
lessons.outcome: Evaluate and justify decisions about revision in the context of debate.
lessons.worked_example_brief: Use a realistic fictional case involving revision; show reasoning, a contrasting case and limitations.
lessons.practice: Analyse an unfamiliar case; defend a choice, identify uncertainty and revise after feedback. Connect the result to structured debate.
lessons.knowledge_check: Explain revision from memory and apply it to a different example; state one limitation.
lessons.evidence_criterion: Accurate explanation of revision; correct application to a new case; clear rationale and limits.

criteria.criterion: Accurate explanation of claims and rebuttals; correct application to a new case; clear rationale and limits.
Accurate explanation of evidence versus rhetoric; correct application to a new case; clear rationale and limits.
Accurate explanation of respectful cross-examination; correct application to a new case; clear rationale and limits.
Accurate explanation of revision; correct application to a new case; clear rationale and limits.

assessment.threshold: All mapped criteria at level 2; no averaging away missing criteria. Level 3 requires independent novel application, delayed reassessment and appropriate review.
assessment.alternate_evidence: Equivalent accessible written, oral, visual, simulated or supervised evidence; no personal disclosure required.
assessment.reviewer: Communication instructor; language instructor as needed.

safety.notes: Respect consent, privacy and applicable rules; source and subject review before publication.
